notes: This contract pins the ordinary IEEE 1516.1-2025 declaration relevance advisories and their per-federate switch accessors to exact official C++ API surfaces. The development profile implements Start/Stop Registration For Object Class and Turn Interactions On/Off for ordinary publication/subscription transitions, with passive subscriptions excluded. Regional declaration advisories, MOM behavior, package evidence, protected review, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside the slice.
